summary: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (earnings release) on May 29, 2026, reporting unreviewed financial results for the six months ended March 31, 2026. Revenues fell 63.1% YoY to US$29.5 million, cost of revenues decreased 62.4% to US$29.3 million, gross profit dropped 82.5% to US$0.24 million, and operating expenses rose 64.6% to US$15.6 million. Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders widened 163.5% to US$13.8 million. The filing does not disclose any transaction or special situation; it is a routine earnings report with no M&A, activist, or strategic review elements.
